problems.title: Mock External Dependencies
problems.description: Write tests for a service that depends on external APIs, databases, and time-sensitive operations.
problems.code_to_test:
class OrderService:
    def __init__(self, db, payment_api, email_service):
        self.db = db
        self.payment_api = payment_api
        self.email_service = email_service
    
    def create_order(self, user_id, items):
        # Calculate total
        total = sum(item['price'] * item['quantity'] for item in items)
        
        # Charge payment
        payment_result = self.payment_api.charge(user_id, total)
        if not payment_result.success:
            raise PaymentError(payment_result.error)
        
        # Save order
        order = self.db.orders.create({
            'user_id': user_id,
            'items': items,
            'total': total,
            'payment_id': payment_result.transaction_id,
            'created_at': datetime.now()
        })
        
        # Send confirmation
        self.email_service.send_order_confirmation(user_id, order)
        
        return order
requirements: Mock payment API with success/failure scenarios

problems.title: Property-Based Testing
problems.description: Write property-based tests using Hypothesis to find edge cases in a sorting/filtering library.
requirements: Use Hypothesis to generate test data
Test sort properties: idempotent, length preserved, ordered
Test filter properties: subset, bounds respected
Test unique properties: no duplicates, subset of input
Find any edge cases the implementation misses

problems.title: Integration Test with Test Containers
problems.description: Write integration tests for a service using real database and cache via test containers.
requirements: Use testcontainers for PostgreSQL and Redis
Test cache hit and miss scenarios

evaluation_criteria.isolation: Tests are isolated from each other
